name: Arizona Fabrication Solutions
old_description: Located in the heart of Queen Creek, Arizona. We are a veteran family owned and operated business, providing all of your metal fabrication needs.
about:
Arizona Fabrication Solutions is based in Queen Creek, Arizona, and was founded in 2013. The company is veteran-owned and family-operated, established by Army veteran Shannon Miazga and Arizona native Bobby Padilla. Miazga brings 12 years of military leadership and 13 years of production management experience, while Padilla contributes local knowledge and a hands-on approach to fabrication.

The shop specializes in custom architectural and structural steel fabrication for residential and commercial construction projects across Arizona. Core services include stair railing replacement and installation, gate fabrication (including entry gates, rolling gates, and block wall removal for larger openings), and custom metal ornamentals such as indoor furniture and outdoor trellises. The team works with architectural and structural steel to deliver tailored metalwork for builders and homeowners.

Primary customers are in the residential and commercial construction sectors, including contractors, architects, and property owners throughout Arizona. Projects range from single-family home railing upgrades to commercial gate installations and decorative metal accents for both interior and exterior applications.

The company emphasizes its veteran-owned, family-operated structure as a differentiator, highlighting a commitment to custom projects and direct client collaboration. Miazga’s background in production management and military leadership informs the shop’s focus on precision and reliability in every fabrication job.
